strategies.name: Pistol group attack A
strategies.when: Prefer on pistol rounds when a fast grouped A attack is appropriate. Keep bomb with supports and the main group.

strategies.name: Pistol group attack B
strategies.when: Prefer on pistol rounds when a fast grouped B attack is appropriate. Keep bomb behind teammates.

strategies.name: Prepare and execute A
strategies.when: Default outside pistols when there is time to gather information. Choose A when team observations suggest fewer defenders there; unknown does not mean clear.

strategies.name: Prepare and execute B
strategies.when: Default outside pistols when B appears weaker from observed contacts and confirmed defender losses. Stage together before executing.

strategies.name: Full buy: probe and execute A
strategies.when: Use with rifles and utility when prior-round reports favor an A opening. Gather observed information on the existing A route, trade contact and use a confirmed A pick to execute early. Keep the original execute deadline and bomb behind the main group.

strategies.name: Full buy: probe and execute B
strategies.when: Use with rifles and utility against repeated A-heavy defenses or confirmed B defender losses. Stage on the existing B route, watch the flank and commit together on the execute call. Unknown B information does not establish an empty site.

strategies.name: Half buy: grouped A trades
strategies.when: Use on a limited purchase when observed A pressure can produce close trades and a recoverable weapon. Stay grouped on the existing A route, avoid isolated sniper duels and keep the bomb behind supports. Do not spend beyond the coordinated half-buy allowance.

strategies.name: Half buy: grouped B trades
strategies.when: Use when the limited purchase suits grouped tunnel fights better than open A approaches. Stage together on the existing B route, trade the entry and recover weapons where safe. Do not send the bomb on a fake or lurk.

strategies.name: Save: economical A attempt
strategies.when: Use when preserving money and current reports make A the better opportunity. Use the existing staged A attack, stay close enough to trade for a weapon and avoid unsupported Long duels. A recovered bomb must be secured before reassessing the site.

strategies.name: Save: economical B attempt
strategies.when: Use on a save round when B is favored by opponent tendencies or confirmed defender losses. Group on the existing B route and trade for weapons while protecting the bomb. Do not mistake an unknown site for a clear one or override team purchase limits.
